content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the panevėžys district court the court has made a final resolution regarding the division of matrimonial property between two parties the applicant has been awarded various movable properties including furniture appliances vehicles and other items they have also been awarded two plots of land the defendant has been ordered to pay the applicant a compensation amount both parties are jointly and severally liable for any creditor obligations related to a credit agreement with a bank the court has discussed various aspects related to matrimonial property and obligations between spouses the court has also ordered the defendant to pay the applicant nonpecuniary damages and the applicant to pay the defendant compensation the court has divided the property acquired during the marriage according to the amended application the costs of the proceedings have been awarded to the applicant the court has decided to dissolve the marriage between the parties involved the text describes the items and their values that are involved in the case including various household items a vehicle furniture appliances and electronics the court orders the defendant to pay the plaintiff a compensation amount over a period of 3 years the plaintiff is also ordered to pay the defendants lawyer costs both parties are required to pay stamp duty fees with the defendant also being responsible for unpaid stamp duty fees the defendant is also ordered to pay the plaintiffs procedural document costs

metadata.cost: - € 100,00 (stamp duty) + € 20,02 (court fees) + € 600,00 (professional fees) to be borne by the applicant; € 408,00 (stamp duty) + € 20,02 (court fees) to be borne by the defendant
